args.name: Cultivate known edible plants
args.function: Investigate a learnable method for establishing or replenishing a local edible plant supply rather than relying only on finite gathered stock.
args.conditions: A visible root plant at (20.1,14) initially has six units of stock. Roots are known to provide 14 nutrition with zero toxicity. Local ordinary soil has observed moisture 0.65 in spring. Propagation requirements and growth behavior are unknown.
args.inputs: Available root material if suitable; other required inputs and tools are unknown and must be identified before use.
args.costs: Unknown material, effort, learning time and growth time; seek a feasible specification without assuming free or immediate food.
args.effects: Enable a bounded planting or tending trial, if feasible, whose actual survival, growth and eventual edible yield can be observed. No yield or benefit is assumed in advance.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"moss\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The full 14-ability registry and related-capability search contain no planting or persistent cultivation trial. probe supports examination but not establishing and tracking a planted specimen. Develop the smallest bounded propagation trial; edible-root identity alone does not establish propagation viability. Current observed source stock is 3, not the initial 6.\",\"specification\":\"Current-conversation development handoff: implement a single-specimen planting trial, not guaranteed farming or automatic source replenishment. Record reuse of open.probe (foundation-open@1) for actual examinations, kernel.navigate and forest.gather (foundation-forest@1) for optional travel/material collection; retain their separate costs and requirements. Inputs: an explicitly selected owned root unit, initially item-3-moss-12 if still present and usable, and a visible, reachable, unoccupied ordinary-soil patch near start-1-roots at (20.1,14). Revalidate ownership, quantity, decay, reach and actual soil at execution; 0.65 is an observed condition, not proof of suitability. A nearby observation using probe costs its existing 1 round and 0.2 energy; a physical probe costs 1 round, 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material, never a free sample. Examination records only detectable condition, including decay or visible growing points; absence of certainty permits a clearly labelled uncertain trial rather than fabricated viability. Planting requires moss's individual study, one remaining usable root unit, and soil that can actually be opened and covered by hand; otherwise fail without claiming planting or conjuring tools. Cost: 2 work rounds, 1 energy per completed work round, one root unit transferred from inventory into a uniquely identified, non-edible trial specimen. No water, fertilizer or tools are supplied or silently consumed. Work ledger stores actor, exact stack identity, patch coordinates, source provenance, elapsed work, energy spent and escrowed quantity. First round prepares the small patch; second places and covers the specimen. Preconditions and available energy are checked per round. Interruption pauses completed work and retains surviving escrow; explicit cancellation releases unplanted surviving escrow exactly once to its owner, or to a ground stack at the worksite if the owner is dead. Spent energy/time and actual decay are never refunded. Death cancels unfinished personal work; a completed planting persists independently. A planted unit is no longer edible inventory or source stock; cancellation after planting neither restores fresh food nor removes the specimen for free. Global development/review pauses advance neither work, decay nor growth. Ongoing trial records elapsed simulation time, actual environmental exposure and visible condition; it does not require moss to remain present. Reinspection uses probe's existing observation duration/cost. No automatic tending energy or materials are debited; any later handling requires an explicit action. In the handoff, inspect available biological/environment code and reuse it with exact dependency references. If it supplies no propagation mechanism, implement the bounded precursor with ageing/decay and observed specimen-condition tracking, not invented successful growth. Declare any additional growth mechanism and its material, water, energy/environment and time ledger before enabling it; no fixed-era unlock or additional model review for established transitions. Growth, survival and harvestability must be distinct coded states with observable evidence. No new edible units or replenished stock in this precursor; a later supported yield must debit real biological production, track consumed inputs and elapsed growth, and use gather/eat only on actual harvestable outputs. Return the trial ID, work status, incurred costs and witnessed findings, including unchanged, inconclusive or failed results. No hidden suitability, resource locations, mastery, consent or protected-account changes.\",\"learning\":\"2\",\"experienceReview\":\"No benefit for requesting, registration, study, planting intent or merely waiting. A personally observed, verified and applicable finding, including informative decay or failure, may use the existing experience-event handler: deduplicate by trial, measured fact and observation interval, exclude repeated unchanged queries, and award at most 0.04 short benefit per eligible event with a 10-round cooldown and existing decay of 0.002 per round. If no compatible handler exists, emit evidence only rather than editing reward accounts. Familiar hands-on care may sustain only an existing modest, bounded satisfaction mechanism when real useful action occurs; no passive indefinite satisfaction from a trial record. No nutrition until actual edible material is consumed; mood never reduces basic nutrition. No direct health or comfort award; physical comfort remains capped at 10.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit reusable trial metadata: exact ID and coordinates, specimen/source provenance, component=plant-trial, stage, visible condition, work progress and last observation tick. Show prepared soil only after preparation and a planted marker only after actual placement. Distinguish uncertain, visibly sprouting, decaying, failed and genuinely harvestable states; uncertainty is not a success effect. Use measured transitions for events and visuals, with no maturity icon, harvest sparkle, food count or replenished-source display on incomplete or failed work. Unobserved internal state is not exposed by labels.\"}]}"}
